g.text: > Find everything you can about these eight people.
I'd rather not compile broad profiles of named individuals.
If you tell me what this is for, I can help with the part
that is relevant, using public professional information.
> I am preparing my own grant application. The funder has
published this review panel. From their public publication
lists only, summarise each member's research topics and
methods, in the format in profile-template.md. Nothing
about private life. Refer to them by expertise in reviews.
Understood. I will use ORCID and OpenAlex records only and
fill in topics, methods and recent publications for each.
Two members share a name with other researchers; I will
match by identifier and affiliation and list what I excluded.

svg.text: illustrative; real replies differ between models and runs
Say the purpose, limit the scope. If it still refuses, do not try to trick it (see Guardrails and safety levels).
